tutorials.title: Welcome
messages: Tap the screen in battle to damage enemies.
Defeat enemies to earn coins, account XP and sometimes skill books.
New features unlock when your account level grows.

tutorials.title: Sprites
messages: Sprites are helpers you can collect.
When you summon helper sprites, they fight beside your selected character.

tutorials.title: Summon
messages: Summons use crystals and can unlock characters, skins, helper sprites and items.
Duplicates increase stars, so old summons still make your team stronger.

tutorials.title: Skill Trees
messages: Skill books unlock upgrades in different skill trees.
Some skills improve tap damage, others improve sprite damage, speed or drop chance.

tutorials.title: Trade
messages: Trade lets you exchange resources when you need a different currency.
Use it carefully because some resources are rarer than others.

tutorials.title: Shop
messages: The shop contains optional crystal packs, battle passes and special packs.
Coins, relics and skill books are still earned by playing.
